name: 2027 ACOG Annual Clinical and Scientific Meeting
organizer: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
description: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists holds its Annual Clinical and Scientific Meeting for obstetrician gynecologists and related clinicians. The 2027 meeting is held in Los Angeles, California.

sources.note: Official future meetings page, fetched directly; confirms 2027 dates (May 21 to 23) and city (Los Angeles)

Official call for proposals page, fetched directly; confirms the call for abstract submissions for ACSM 2027 is open and that the session proposal call has already closed, but does not publish an exact abstract deadline
Official homepage, fetched directly; content was focused on the 2026 Washington DC meeting and did not list a 2027 venue name or address

notes: The official site confirms the 2027 meeting dates and city but had not published an exact abstract submission deadline, a named venue, or a registration deadline as of 2026-09-10 despite the abstract call already being open; the deadlines list is therefore left empty rather than estimated. City center coordinates are used since no specific venue was found. This session's web search quota was exhausted before a further attempt could be made to find the exact abstract deadline via search, so only official-page fetch results are reflected here.
